item.description: Ruston, La. (KTVE/KARD) -- Louisiana Tech basketball recently placed a new Jersey in the rafters and immortalizing Paul Millsap in Dunkin' dog lore forever, a moment he won’t ever forget and carving out a journey for many more to follow after.

item.title: Arkansas Supreme Court ruling allows candidate to remain in House race in hot check controversy
item.description: The Arkansas Supreme Court ruled that Laura "Missy" Michelle Wardlaw, a Republican candidate for Arkansas House District 94, is eligible to remain in the race despite her 2018 violation of the Arkansas Hot Check Law, as the court found that she did not enter a guilty plea, appear in court, or be found guilty by a court.

item.title: History Starts Now: Bayou Jamb Softball set to make debut
item.description: MONROE, La. (KTVE/KARD) — Bayou Jamb Softball is set to make its debut this weekend with two days of competitive action on the campus of ULM. Participating teams got their first taste of the Bayou Jamb experience at Bayou Jamb Media Day, letting fans know what they can expect this season.
